venceEl: Expires on {{fecha}}, in {{dias}} days. After that, access is rejected with “Subscription expired”.
sitiosSoloLectura: The account manages its properties and doors from the app. Here they are read-only.
sinSuscripcion: This account has no active subscription. Its doors reject access.

noEncontrada.texto: It may have been removed or the link may be wrong.

sitiosVacio.texto: The account creates them from the app.

venceHoy: Expires on {{fecha}}, today. After that, access is rejected with “Subscription expired”.
vencioEl: Expired on {{fecha}}, {{dias}} days ago. Access is rejected with “Subscription expired”.
suspendidaTexto: The subscription is suspended. Access is rejected until it is reactivated.
cambiarCodigoTexto: The first 3 letters of every user's PIN become the new code. The rest of the PIN stays the same and nobody gets a new PIN; they just type the new letters. Open sessions are not closed.
administradoresVacio: This account has no active administrators.
regenerarTexto: A new PIN is drawn and shown only once. The previous one stops working and their sessions are closed. The PINs of the other users are regenerated by each administrator from the app.
pinNuevoAviso: This PIN won't be shown again. Share it and hand it to whoever manages the account.
eliminarTexto: Nobody in this account will be able to sign in again, neither to the app nor with their QR codes. Its data is kept for the audit log and accounting, and its code becomes free. This action can't be undone from the panel.
pendienteAviso: This account hasn't paid its first year yet: it generates no QR and opens no doors until the payment is recorded.
pendienteTexto: Pending its first payment: it starts operating once it is recorded.
sinResponsable: This account has no contact details.
agregarAdminTexto: An administrator creates the Holders and Guards of their branch. Their PIN is drawn (or you choose the last 4 characters) and shown only once. It counts toward the plan’s user quota.
agregarAdminSufijoAyuda: Optional. Leave it empty to have them drawn.
agregarAdminSufijoInvalido: It is 4 characters, letters and numbers.
adminNuevoAviso: This PIN is not shown again. Share it and hand it over in person or through a private channel.
errorJerarquia: We could not load the account structure
ramaVacia: It has no Holders or Guards yet.
reasignarTextoGuardia: The Guard will report to another administrator of the account. The quota does not change and it is recorded in the log.
reasignarTextoTitular_one: The Holder will report to another administrator, with their unit and their {{count}} Member. The quota does not change and it is recorded in the log.
reasignarTextoTitular_other: The Holder will report to another administrator, with their unit and their {{count}} Members. The quota does not change and it is recorded in the log.
maxMiembrosAyuda: How many Members each Holder of this account can create.
maxMiembrosInvalido: Enter a whole number from 1 to {{max}}.
usoAviso: For information only. Inactive: no QR generated in {{dias}} days. Noisy: more than {{qr}} QR generated in a single day. Each administrator decides who to remove.
usoSinRuidosos: Nobody generates too many QR codes.
usoSinTitulares: No Holder is near their Member limit.
usoDetalleNuncaGeneroQr: No QR in {{dias}} days · never generated one
usoDetalleInactivo: No QR in {{dias}} days · the last was on {{fecha}}
usoDetalleRuidoso: Up to {{maximo}} QR in a day · {{total}} in total
errorUso: We could not load the user activity
